_README: Every human judgement about this ROM lives in this file; the
generated listings are disposable, so renaming is free.
What to do next, roughly in order:
Read the coverage it reports. Low coverage is normal at
first and is the number you are trying to move.
2. Every unresolved indirect jump it reports is a hole. Add the
target to `entries`, or the pointer pair to `ram_vectors` if
the handler is installed into RAM.
Finds the sound code and the tables feeding it.
4. Name things in `labels` as soon as you know what they are.
See docs/method.md for the working order and docs/pitfalls.md for
the traps that each cost real time.

comments.f7:C2B1: Per-player phase byte ram_00B4,X indexes the RTS table at C2C4: 0 waves, 1 wait for slots $12-$1F to empty, 2 warp out, 3 level boss, 4 asteroid field, 5 final boss, 6 end of turn. (code; phases 0-5 seen live in work/runs/long1 and final)
comments.f7:C2E8: One wave frame: three spawn rolls (D0F3, D46A, CE23), the saucer roll, every $A0 passes an asteroid, then HUD, objects and the frame wait. The wave index ram_0047 steps when the NMI's seconds timer fires (ram_004B), every 20 s. (live: 1200 frames a step)
comments.f7:D46A: Spawn roll, family 'homer' (type 6): only while the player is alive, only if Random >= WaveSpawnThreshold ($43), and only into a free slot from WaveFloorHomer ($44) up to $1F. The floor is the cap on how many can be alive. (live: poking $44=$14 and $43=$F0 gave 12 alive, slots $14-$1F)
comments.f7:D9CE: Player shot against everything: Y runs $1F down to 1 and a slot is a target when its type is 1-7 (type < 8). Box test with the target's own ObjBoxW/ObjBoxH. No early outs beyond the type test. (code)
comments.f7:DA47: With a level boss up (BossId >= 0) a shot tests only the boss's pieces, from slot dat_E8A5[BossId] to $1F: box = piece position + (ObjBoxW, ObjBoxH) offsets with sizes in ObjB/ObjA, hit points in ObjC ($FF = not a target). (code; hit points seen live only on the final boss)
comments.f7:DBB0: Final boss: eleven hit zones in four arrays at $1AA0 (hit points, negative = locked or dead), $1AAB (x), $1AB6 (width), $1AC1 (bottom y). A zone going negative runs its own handler from the table at DC19, which pokes the wrecked art into the zone lists' fixed heads and unlocks the next zone. (live: hit points count down, ram_0090 9->7, work/runs/final)
comments.f7:E207: Level boss brain. All pieces carry this type, but the handler sets CurSlot to the boss's first slot so the object loop skips the other pieces: it runs once a pass. One piece a pass may fire (round robin in ram_1A75); movement comes from a (count, move) script and a divider indexed by pieces left (dat_E8AB). (code)
comments.f7:E858: Boss time limit: when the 70 s timer fires the boss leaves downward, and reaching the bottom costs the Earth shield $4000 (index 6 of dat_F52F). (code; a timed-out boss seen live in work/runs/long1, 4215 frames)
comments.f7:FD99: NMI. Reset and Select are polled here and rewrite the stacked return address to restart the game; then JMP (ram_1A50): FE02 in play, FEED on the title and end screens, FF23 while paused.
comments.f7:FE02: The one DLI of the game screen, on the HUD text zone (raster 227 in MAME): CTRL to 320 mode for the text, then the seconds timers, the sound start (bank 3), the sound tick (bank 4), the display-list build (bank 3), the stars, and CTRL back to 160 mode. It switches banks three times and restores ram_00B7 at the end. Not usable under BankSet as is.
comments.b3:9000: Display-list build, run from the NMI every frame. Fill pointers for the 11 zones are reset to ZoneHeadLen; each live object is dispatched through a 256-entry table on its Y to one of 24 unrolled placers (one or two zones, the zone's list address and fill byte hard-coded). ram_0073 is taken to 0 for the duration so a second NMI skips it. (live: 25-54 raster lines, about a line an object, work/runs/fp1)
comments.b3:B000: Stars: 18 characters in a 20-column map at $1B00, one star a column. A step adds 2 to the star's character (the same dot one line lower); at the end of its set the cell is blanked and the star moves 20 bytes on (the next zone). Run every StarPeriod frames from the NMI.
comments.b1:B900: Wave record: row = dat1_B948[Level] + WaveIndex into four parallel tables: threshold (B94F), then the three slot floors (B9B1, BA13, BA75); a non-zero floor gets +1 on Easy. (live: values match in work/runs/long1)

blocks.name: WaveRowBase
blocks.note: level -> first row (14 rows a level)

blocks.name: WaveThreshold
blocks.note: 7 levels x 14 waves: spawn when Random >= this

blocks.name: DllTemplates
blocks.note: two DLL images (1 player at +0, 2 players at +$40), each ending $FF, copied to $1F00

blocks.name: ZoneHeads
blocks.note: 16 bytes per list: star map header (indirect, 18 chars) and a dummy 5-byte header that sets write mode 1; then the HUD lists

blocks.name: FinalBossZones
blocks.note: 11 x hit points, x, width, bottom y

blocks.name: PlacerByY
blocks.note: hi then lo bytes (target-1) of the placer for each Y

blocks.name: BossDefs
blocks.note: per boss: bank of its art, piece count, pointer to 14 rows of piece-count bytes

blocks.name: SoundIdToStreams
blocks.note: per id: stream for voice 0, stream for voice 1 ($FF = leave)

blocks.name: CapsuleSeqPtrs
blocks.note: per level, pointer to a 40-byte capsule order
